x: We won the Weight Putt with Grassau and Melchior, also the Javelin with George Powell and, once again, Melchior, who, by the way, materially contributed to our total of points.
Grassau, Jones and Bill Sutton monopolised the crowd once they started, and apparently they had not met men of their magnificent physique before.
Jones had an excellent win in the Shot Putt with 39ft. 1in.—the best performance yet in Club events by "home" talent—only Grassau and Pfenninger having beaten it.
